integration_issues.flow: Prepare hash handler — same-document hash navigation
integration_issues.issue: If the user is already on /app/prepare and navigation only changes the hash (e.g. client-side <a href="#brief-x">), the useEffect does NOT re-fire because its dependency array is [cid, openBriefById] and neither changes across a pure hash change. This is ONLY a concern if any in-app link sets the hash without a full navigation; the iter66 Studio history briefing row already bypasses this by opening a PDF blob directly, and the primary deep-link path is fresh navigation (email link, new tab, etc.) where it works correctly. Consider adding a hashchange window-event listener for completeness — but NOT currently breaking any real user flow.

action_items: (OPTIONAL / LOW PRIORITY) Add a window.addEventListener('hashchange', ...) on Prepare to cover same-document hash navigations — currently works only on fresh navigation + cid-mount, but no caller uses same-doc hash change so it does not block any shipped flow.

(OPTIONAL) ActiveWorkflowsRail tile testid pattern — iter66 note suggested it uses `onClick + window.location.assign` (full reload) rather than a react-router <Link>. Still not migrated in iter67. Nice-to-have for SPA prefetch consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: Prepare.jsx — TDZ fix VERIFIED correct: openBriefById useCallback at line 133, hash useEffect at line 149. hashHandledRef pattern is a sound guard against strict-mode double-fire and back-to-back cid mounts. Regex ^#brief-([\w-]+)$ correctly accepts UUIDs with hyphens.

Decks.jsx 907-934 — Briefing row click uses authenticated fetch→blob→window.open. Adds Authorization header from localStorage token + credentials:'include'. Revokes object URL after 60s. Correct pattern. One nit: the fetch Error path only toasts a generic message; consider logging for observability in Sentry/console.
studio.py engagement endpoint — plan defaults to 'free' when account.plan is missing. Normalises lowercase, unlocks only 'pro'/'team'. Clean.
studio_sensitivity.score_sensitivity_with_llm_tiebreaker — fallback_only short-circuit + 200-char min + no-downgrade rule all preserved. Belt-and-braces good.
